cameron: quick sanity check — prepping a new checkpoint for onboarding (model: nova-lite-13b). where should the safetensors go in the bucket so infra picks up auto-validate?
sophia: path should be s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-lite-13b/<version>/weights/ — include manifest.json next to shards.
ryan: note: manifest must include `shard_layout` and `tp_size` fields. infra lint will fail otherwise.
jia: question about sharding: model was exported with TP=2 on source machine. we plan to serve with TP=8. do we re-shard or serve using fallback?
sophia: re-shard if possible. fallback mapping exists but performance/regression risk. +1 to re-shard and run small eval.
cameron: can we do safetensors -> re-shard -> quantize pipeline? my plan: safetensors -> convert -> reshape shards -> fp16 -> upload.
ryan: pipeline looks good. watch out for tokenizer mismatch: this repo's tokenizer.json expects byte-level BPE, source is sentencepiece. if you upload mismatched tokenizer we get weird UNK tokens.
jia: saw that — token counts off by ~40 for common words. should we canonicalize to our tokenizers/ folder and reference by model config?
sophia: yes, put tokenizer files in s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-lite-13b/<version>/tokenizer/ and set config.json tokenizer_type -> "byte_bpe" or "sentencepiece" explicitly.
infra-bot: uploaded file integrity: sha256 checksums required. Run `tools/checksum.py` before upload.
ryan: example convert command I used:```bash
python tools/convert_to_safetensors.py --input /tmp/checkpoint.pt --out /tmp/nova_shard_000.safetensors --dtype fp16
```
cameron: for dtype — prefer bf16 for training checkpoints but fp16 for serving on current GPU fleet (A10x/RTX6000). so convert to fp16 for hosted.
jia: also note quantization profile: use dynamic-8k context quantization for chat workloads. add quant_profile.json next to manifest.
sophia: validation checklist before marking onboard-ready: weights path correct, manifest + shard_layout, tokenizer files present, checksum, config.json with model dims and tp_size, sample prompts pass baseline eval.
cameron: ping @sophia @ryan i'll push a draft PR with re-shard scripts and a small eval harness. can someone review when free? :eyes:
ryan: I can review tomorrow morning.
jia: I'll run tokenizer diff and perf smoke tests.
mlops-bot: Validation run queued (id: val-87321) — will post results to thread when done. :gear:
infra-bot: Reminder: use naming convention `nova-lite-13b-v1.2.0-<date>-sha256.sigs` for release artifacts.
sophia: one more gotcha — model config uses `tensor_parallelism: 8` and `tp_shard_format: interleaved` for our runtime. if your conversion tool outputs contiguous shards, set `tp_shard_format: contiguous` and call out in manifest. runtime can auto-detect but explicit is safer.
cameron: thanks all. I'll update the manifest template and upload a first draft by EOD PST. posting links once uploaded. :shipit:
mlops-bot: Validation run complete: small-eval passed (perplexity delta < 0.02), tokenizer diff flagged 12 token mismatches — see s3://redwood-models/onboard/nova-lite-13b/v1.2.0/validation/report.html
ryan: good signal. jia can you triage token mismatches tomorrow?
jia: yep will dig in and update tokenizer files or add mapping layer.
sophia: awesome. when PR links go up add the `onboard-checklist` label so release tooling picks it up.
